description: This file defines the DiskStorageService class responsible for managing local storage persistence, including key-value storage and payload encryption/decryption, within the Standard Notes project. It handles storage policies, encryption policies, payload management, and diagnostics.

classes.name: DiskStorageService
classes.description: A service class responsible for local storage persistence, including key-value storage, payload encryption/decryption, and storage policies within the Standard Notes ecosystem.

methods.name: provideEncryptionProvider
methods.description: Sets the encryption provider used for encrypting and decrypting payloads.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up references and state when the service is deinitialized.

methods.name: handleApplicationStage
methods.description: Handles different application lifecycle stages, initializing storage persistence and encryption policies accordingly.

methods.name: setPersistencePolicy
methods.description: Sets the storage persistence policy, e.g., ephemeral or persistent, and clears storage if ephemeral.

methods.name: setEncryptionPolicy
methods.description: Configures the encryption policy and optionally persists this setting.

methods.name: isEphemeralSession
methods.description: Checks if the current storage session is ephemeral.

methods.name: initializeFromDisk
methods.description: Loads storage data from disk and initializes internal state.

methods.name: setInitialValues
methods.description: Sets initial storage values, ensuring proper structure and unwrapping if needed.

methods.name: isStorageWrapped
methods.description: Determines if the storage data is encrypted/wrapped.

methods.name: canDecryptWithKey
methods.description: Checks if the storage can be decrypted with a given root key.

methods.name: decryptWrappedValue
methods.description: Decrypts a wrapped storage payload using the provided key.

methods.name: decryptStorage
methods.description: Decrypts the entire storage payload.

methods.name: persistValuesToDisk
methods.description: Persists current storage values to disk, debounced.

methods.name: awaitPersist
methods.description: Waits for ongoing persistence operations to complete.

methods.name: immediatelyPersistValuesToDisk
methods.description: Immediately persists storage values to disk.

methods.name: generatePersistableValues
methods.description: Generates a payload suitable for storage, encrypting if needed.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in storage and triggers persistence.

methods.name: setValueAndAwaitPersist
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair and waits for persistence to complete.

methods.name: setValueWithNoPersist
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair without triggering persistence.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a given key and mode, with optional default.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from storage and persists the change.

methods.name: getStorageEncryptionPolicy
methods.description: Returns the current storage encryption policy.

methods.name: getPersistenceKey
methods.description: Returns the key used for persisting storage data.

methods.name: defaultValuesObject
methods.description: Creates a default storage values object.

methods.name: DefaultValuesObject
methods.description: Static method to create a default storage values object.

methods.name: domainKeyForMode
methods.description: Returns the storage domain key for a given mode.

methods.name: clearValues
methods.description: Clears simple key-value storage data.

methods.name: getAllRawPayloads
methods.description: Retrieves all raw payloads from storage.

methods.name: savePayload
methods.description: Saves a single payload to storage.

methods.name: savePayloads
methods.description: Saves multiple payloads, handling encryption and payload splitting.

methods.name: deletePayloads
methods.description: Deletes specified payloads by UUID.

methods.name: forceDeletePayloads
methods.description: Forcefully deletes specified payloads.

methods.name: deletePayloadWithId
methods.description: Deletes a payload by its UUID.

methods.name: clearAllPayloads
methods.description: Removes all payloads from storage.

methods.name: clearAllData
methods.description: Clears all storage data and payloads, including raw storage values.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Provides diagnostic information about the storage state.
